verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a sandbox-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only per-sandbox actions: creating a named sandbox, running a command, and stopping a single sandbox from the dashboard. Key-value tags let users categorize sandboxes, but no documented action applies to many sandboxes or items at once. SDK scripting is a developer building block rather than a bulk-operation feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
